prompt:
Character reference sheet, one wide image in two parts, photorealistic photograph. LEFT two-thirds: full-body turnaround of the same person, three views side by side at identical scale: front view, exact 90-degree side view, exact 180-degree back view, relaxed A-pose. RIGHT third: close-up head-and-shoulders portrait of the SAME person facing camera, mouth closed. Plain light-grey background, soft even studio light at a neutral white balance, no shadows, healthy natural skin with real texture, not airbrushed, no text, no labels, no watermark.
The person: Ji Hongyuan, a fictional 56-year-old, Ji Ran's father; a calculating wealthy businessman; the face, skin and build of exactly that age, which the role does not change. Appearance: Ordinary-looking East Asian man in his mid-fifties. He has a square, heavy-jawed face with deep nasolabial lines, thin lips and narrow, hard eyes. His salt-and-pepper grey hair is short and combed back neatly. He is about 174 cm, solid and broad-chested with a slight paunch. He wears thin gold-rimmed glasses and a gold watch.. Wearing one outfit only: A tailored dark chocolate-brown suit jacket and matching brown trousers. A cream long-sleeved dress shirt, open at the collar with no tie. Polished brown leather loafers.. Signature colour: brown. In the close-up a calm, attractive expression with bright, intelligent eyes and only a hint of: Domineering, status-obsessed and transactional. He sees his daughter's marriage as a business deal and is contemptuous of anyone without money.; no tears. The full-body views keep the body's build and proportions as the appearance gives them, head-to-body ratio included, never slimmer. Cast as a commercial live-action short drama: an adult lead (the heroine, the hero) or a young adult woman in a prominent role is a strikingly beautiful or handsome, camera-ready actor, with the figure, make-up, hair and fitted outfit the appearance and outfit give; a character under 18 looks and dresses like an ordinary child or teenager of that age and is never styled to look sexy; any other supporting role is an ordinary-looking person of that age.
The outfit is identical in every view and in the close-up: the same garments, accessories and details on the same side of the body, seen from that view's angle (an earring on the left ear stays on the left ear; a tie, a pocket square, gloves or hair ribbons are in every view or in none). Garments are plain, with no logo, brand mark, or printed letters or numbers.

Avoid: a different face between the views, an older-looking or younger-looking face than 56, doll-like face, a second outfit, extra people, extra limbs, text or labels.
